title: fix(audit): exit non-zero when pip-audit cannot be run

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+``pipenv audit`` now exits with status 1 instead of 0 when ``pip-audit`` could not be installed, was declined, or is still missing after installing, so CI no longer treats an audit that never ran as a pass.

@@ -192,15 +192,16 @@ def do_audit(  # noqa: PLR0913
     if not is_pip_audit_installed(project, system=system):
         if not install_pip_audit(project, system=system):
             console.print("[yellow]Vulnerability audit aborted.[/yellow]")
-            return
+            # Nothing was audited: a non-zero exit keeps CI from reading it as a pass.
+            sys.exit(1)

             )
-            return
+            sys.exit(1)

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+"""Tests for the exit status of ``pipenv.routines.audit.do_audit``."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from unittest import mock
+
+import pytest
+
+from pipenv.routines import audit
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def audit_project():
+    proj = mock.MagicMock()
+    proj.s.is_quiet.return_value = True
+    return proj
+
+
+def test_audit_exits_non_zero_when_pip_audit_is_not_installed(
+    monkeypatch, audit_project
+):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(audit, "is_pip_audit_installed", lambda *a, **kw: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(audit, "install_pip_audit", lambda *a, **kw: False)
+    run = mock.MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(audit.subprocess, "run", run)
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc:
+        audit.do_audit(audit_project, system=True, quiet=True)
+
+    assert exc.value.code == 1
+    run.assert_not_called()
+
+
+def test_audit_exits_non_zero_when_pip_audit_is_missing_after_install(
+    monkeypatch, audit_project
+):
+    # Not found before the install, still not found after it "succeeded".
+    monkeypatch.setattr(audit, "is_pip_audit_installed", lambda *a, **kw: False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(audit, "install_pip_audit", lambda *a, **kw: True)
+    run = mock.MagicMock()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(audit.subprocess, "run", run)
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc:
+        audit.do_audit(audit_project, system=True, quiet=True)
+
+    assert exc.value.code == 1
+    run.assert_not_called()
